properties.description: Planned 2026-09-23 on Anthony's word ("Schedule the small half"), from the dev_reflow2 hub, after the flo2 → reflow2 relay of 2026-09-22. It is ordered right after epoch:planned-the-composition-blockers-and-the-two-steps-that-were-passed-over (560), which reflow2's own session said does not include this. IN IT: req:a-session-names-the-person-it-writes-for-and-the-server-remembers-it, the small half of flo2's levied ask: a caller-declared contributor per session, used for attribution only, on trust. NOT IN IT, deliberately: the automatic change journal (clause 2 of req:a-write-carries-who-made-it-and-the-server-records-that-it-happened), which waits on dec:idea-should-the-server-journal-every-write-itself and flo2's open "one timeline or two lists" question. Also not in it: any use of a caller-declared identity for AUTHORITY, which stays open in dec:idea-may-a-caller-asserted-identity-be-trusted-and-for-what. No date is given; the sequence is the plan.
properties.name: PLANNED — a write says who it was for: a session names its contributor once, and every write is attributed to it
